태양의 질량은 태양계 전체의 99.86%를 차지하고, 나머지 대부분은 목: The Sun holds 99.86% of the mass of the whole solar system, and most of the rest is Jupiter. Every second it turns about 600 million tonnes of hydrogen into helium, and about 4 million tonnes of that is lost as energy. Even after burning for so long, the mass it has lost to fusion is only about 0.03% of the total. Particles stream out of the Sun at about 400 → 800 km per second as the solar wind and blow to the edge of the solar system. In September 1859 the English astronomer Carrington saw a bright flash above a sunspot, and the next day the strongest geomagnetic storm on record hit Earth: telegraph machines threw sparks and auroras were seen even in the tropics.
수성의 중심에는 철로 된 큰 핵이 있어 반지름의 약 85%를 차지하고,: Mercury has a large iron core that makes up about 85% of its radius, and its density is the second highest after Earth's. Although it is a small planet, it has a magnetic field. Its largest impact scar is the Caloris Basin, about 1,550 km across. When Mercury's orbit drifted slightly from what Newton's laws predicted, some people in the 19th century even proposed a planet called Vulcan inside its orbit, but Einstein's general relativity explained the drift in 1915. MESSENGER ended its mission by crashing onto the surface on April 30, 2015, when its fuel ran out, and the European and Japanese BepiColombo is due to enter orbit around Mercury in November 2026.
금성은 자전 주기가 243일로 공전 주기 225일보다 깁니다. 1761년: Venus takes 243 days to rotate once, which is longer than its 225-day year. In 1761 the Russian scientist Lomonosov watched Venus cross the face of the Sun and saw a ring of light blur around it, and he guessed that Venus has an atmosphere. In 1970 Venera 7 became the first probe to send a signal from the surface of another planet, and for 23 minutes it reported a temperature of about 475 degrees. From 1990 to 1994 the American Magellan mapped 98% of the surface by radar and showed volcanoes and lava plains spread over much of the planet.
지구는 중심으로 갈수록 뜨거워져, 고체인 철 내핵의 온도가 태양 표면과: The deeper you go inside Earth, the hotter it gets, and the solid iron inner core is about 5,400 degrees, close to the temperature of the Sun's surface. The liquid outer core around it moves and makes the magnetic field. Around 240 BC, Eratosthenes measured the length of a stick's shadow in two cities and calculated the size of Earth, and his value is said to be not far from today's. In December 1968 the astronauts of Apollo 8 photographed Earth rising over the Moon. A day on Earth is not exactly 24 hours: measured against the stars it is 23 hours 56 minutes. Oxygen began to build up in the air about 2.4 billion years ago, when photosynthetic life became abundant.
달의 인력은 바닷물을 끌어 하루에 두 번씩 밀물과 썰물을 만들고, 그 마: The Moon's gravity pulls on the sea and makes two high tides and two low tides a day, and the friction from this slows Earth's spin very slowly. In 1959 the Soviet Luna 3 took the first pictures of the far side of the Moon, which cannot be seen from Earth. On July 20, 1969, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin of Apollo 11 became the first people to land on the Moon, and the whole Apollo program brought back about 382 kg of Moon rock. The surface climbs to 127 degrees by day and falls to minus 173 degrees at night. In January 2019 China's Chang'e 4 made the first landing on the far side.
화성의 이름은 붉은빛 때문에 로마 신화의 전쟁의 신에서 따왔습니다. 19: Mars was named after the Roman god of war because of its red color. The first close-up pictures, taken by Mariner 4 in 1965, showed a Moon-like land covered with craters. In 1976 Viking 1 and Viking 2 became the first probes to land on the surface and analyze the soil. Perseverance landed in Jezero Crater in February 2021, and the helicopter Ingenuity that went with it made the first powered flight on another planet on April 19, then flew 72 times until January 2024. On Mars a day is counted as 24 hours 39 minutes 35 seconds and is called a sol.
포보스라는 이름은 그리스 신화에서 전쟁의 신 아레스의 아들인 공포의 신에: The name Phobos comes from the Greek god of fear, a son of the war god Ares. The large crater Stickney is named after the maiden name of Angeline Stickney, the wife of the discoverer Asaph Hall. Its average density is only about 1.9 g per cm³, lower than rock, so it may be a heap of rubble with many empty spaces inside. Long grooves run in lines across its surface, looking as if they spread out from the Stickney side. The novel Gulliver's Travels, published in 1726, mentions two moons of Mars, more than 150 years before they were really found. Japan is preparing a probe called MMX to bring back soil from Phobos.
아사프 홀은 위성 찾기를 그만두려 했으나 아내 앤절린이 하룻밤만 더 해: Asaph Hall was about to give up the search for moons, but his wife Angeline urged him to try one more night, and that night in August 1877 he is said to have found Deimos. The name comes from the Greek god of dread, another son of Ares. Deimos orbits close to the distance where a body goes around in about one Martian day, so once it rises over Mars it stays in the sky for more than two days. It is only about 12 km across, its escape speed is just 5.6 m per second, and its gravity is so weak that a hard-thrown ball would fly off into space. Its dark surface that seems rich in carbon is like that of an asteroid.
목성의 질량은 나머지 행성을 모두 합친 것의 2.5배쯤이지만, 태양의 1: Jupiter has about 2.5 times the mass of all the other planets put together, but only one thousandth the mass of the Sun, so it never became a star. Pioneer 10 was the first to fly close to it in 1973, and from 1995 to 2003 Galileo orbited it and dropped a probe into its atmosphere. Since 2016 Juno has been passing over the polar regions and studying what lies beneath the clouds. In July 1994 Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 broke into 21 pieces and struck Jupiter over six days, leaving dark marks that could be seen from Earth.
이오는 1610년 1월 갈릴레이가 찾았고, 이름은 제우스의 사랑을 받은: Galileo found Io in January 1610, and its name comes from a nymph loved by Zeus. In March 1979 Linda Morabito recognized in a Voyager 1 picture that a cloud-like shape rising at the edge was a volcanic plume. Plumes can reach 300 km high. The largest volcano, Loki Patera, holds a lava lake more than 200 km across, and in some places the lava is hotter than 1,200 degrees. The orbital periods of Io, Europa and Ganymede are locked in a ratio of 1 to 2 to 4, so their pulls on each other keep distorting Io's orbit.
갈릴레오 탐사선이 1990년대 말 유로파 곁의 자기장이 달라지는 것을 재: In the late 1990s the Galileo spacecraft measured changes in the magnetic field near Europa and found evidence of electrically conducting salt water beneath the ice. In 2012 the Hubble Space Telescope photographed what looked like water vapor plumes rising near the south pole. The ice shell is thought to be 15 to 25 km thick. Jupiter's strong radiation pours onto the surface, and a person standing there would receive a deadly dose within a day. Europa Clipper was launched on October 14, 2024, and it will pass Europa 49 times to measure the thickness of the ice and the saltiness of the ocean, and to judge whether conditions could support life.
가니메데라는 이름은 그리스 신화에서 제우스의 술시중을 들게 된 트로이의: Ganymede is named after the Trojan youth who became Zeus's cupbearer in Greek myth. In 1996 the Galileo spacecraft found a magnetic field at Ganymede, the first ever found at a moon. In 2015 the Hubble Space Telescope studied how Ganymede's auroras sway and showed evidence of a salt-water ocean underground. That ocean is thought to hold more water than all the oceans of Earth together. In June 2022 Juno passed within 1,000 km and photographed the icy surface up close. Europe's JUICE is due to reach Jupiter in 2031 and enter orbit around Ganymede in December 2034.
이름은 제우스의 사랑을 받다가 곰으로 변한 요정에서 왔고, 1610년 갈: Its name comes from a nymph whom Zeus loved and who was turned into a bear, and Galileo discovered it in 1610. It lies about 1.88 million km from Jupiter, which makes it the outermost of the large moons. Unlike Io and Europa, its orbit is not locked with other moons, so tides produce almost no heat, and its inside is thought never to have separated fully into rock and ice but stayed mixed. Changes in the magnetic field measured by the Galileo spacecraft suggest that a salt-water ocean may lie deep under the ice. On the surface, sunlight has eroded the ice and left sharp hills tens of meters high, and there is a very thin atmosphere of carbon dioxide.
토성이라는 이름은 로마 신화의 농사 신 사투르누스에서 왔고, 영어의 토요: The name Saturn comes from Saturnus, the Roman god of farming, and the English word Saturday has the same root. In 1610 Galileo saw the rings on either side of Saturn as two large moons, and in 1655 Huygens explained that a thin, flat ring surrounds the planet. Saturn goes around the Sun once in 29.5 years, and its axis is tilted 26.7 degrees, so the look of the rings changes. About every 15 years the rings are seen edge-on and almost seem to vanish from Earth, the latest time being March 2025. When its fuel ran out, Cassini plunged into Saturn's atmosphere on September 15, 2017, and ended its mission.
미마스라는 이름은 그리스 신화의 거인에서 왔고, 이름을 붙인 사람은 윌리: The name Mimas comes from a giant in Greek myth, and it was given by John Herschel, the son of William Herschel. The largest crater, Herschel, honors his father William Herschel, the discoverer. Its density is 1.15 g per cm³, ice with a little rock mixed in. Ring particles at the inner edge of the gap orbit in half the time Mimas does, so they are tugged again and again by Mimas and thrown out of that lane, which leaves the Cassini Division empty. A 2024 study, based on tiny wobbles in Mimas's orbit, reported that it may have an ocean under the ice that formed only 5 → 15 million years ago.
카시니는 2015년 10월 28일 엔셀라두스 남극에서 49km 위를 스치: On October 28, 2015, Cassini swept 49 km above the south pole of Enceladus and found molecular hydrogen in the plume. The hydrogen is thought to come from hot rock on the sea floor reacting with water. Earlier, tiny grains of silica that seemed to have been washed out from the sea bed were found, and these were read as a sign that parts of the water are hotter than 90 degrees. The ice shell at the south pole is only about 5 km thick, so water leaks out easily. More than 100 vents lie along the tiger stripes, and they were measured to spray about 200 kg of water vapor per second.
테티스라는 이름은 그리스 신화의 티탄 여신에서 왔고, 토성 위성의 이름들: The name Tethys comes from a Titan goddess in Greek myth, and the names of Saturn's moons were chosen by John Herschel in 1847. Its surface reflects sunlight very well because ice dust sprayed out by Enceladus falls on it like fresh snow. The crater Odysseus has slowly sunk in the middle over a long time and is now spread out like a round bowl, and it is named after the hero of Homer's Odyssey. Ithaca Chasma is also named after the home island of Odysseus. Cassini passed close to Tethys in 2005 and 2015 and photographed its surface.
디오네의 이름은 그리스 신화에서 제우스의 연인이며 아프로디테의 어머니로: The name Dione comes from the Titan goddess of Greek myth, known as a lover of Zeus and the mother of Aphrodite. Its density is 1.48 g per cm³, the third highest among Saturn's moons after Titan and Enceladus, and rock makes up about a third of it. In 2005 Cassini swept past Dione and confirmed that the bright streaks on the trailing hemisphere are not paint but ice cliffs. A 2016 study measured its gravity and concluded that an ocean might lie about 100 km deep, above the rocky core. In 2012 a very thin oxygen atmosphere was also confirmed. Its orbital period is locked to that of Enceladus at 1 to 2, so the two affect each other.
레아의 이름은 그리스 신화에서 제우스의 어머니이자 크로노스의 아내인 티탄: The name Rhea comes from the Titan goddess of Greek myth who was the mother of Zeus and wife of Cronus. Cronus corresponds to Saturnus, the Roman god who gave Saturn its name. Cassini found Rhea in December 1672, after Iapetus in 1671, and with Tethys and Dione in 1684 he found four of Saturn's moons in all. Its density is a low 1.24 g per cm³, and rock makes up about a quarter of it. The largest crater, Tirawa, is about 360 km across. In 2008 a claim, based on Cassini particle measurements, that Rhea might have rings drew attention, but later close-up pictures did not show any rings.
타이탄은 1655년 3월 하위헌스가 찾은 토성의 첫 위성이고, 이름은 존: Titan was the first moon of Saturn to be found, by Huygens in March 1655, and its name was chosen by John Herschel. Its largest sea, Kraken Mare, is more than 1,000 km long and about as large as the Caspian Sea. Huygens parachuted down on January 14, 2005, for about two and a half hours, then sent signals for a little over 70 minutes after landing, and the ground was like damp sand strewn with rounded pebbles of ice. Because the air is thick and gravity is one seventh of Earth's, it is said that a person with wings strapped to the arms could fly. Dragonfly is due to launch in 2028 and arrive in 2034.
이아페투스는 이름이 그리스 신화의 티탄에서 왔습니다. 검은 쪽은 카시니: Iapetus is named after a Titan of Greek myth. The dark side is called Cassini Regio and the bright side Roncevaux Terra, a name that comes from the medieval epic The Song of Roland. The ridge along the equator is about 200 km wide and is among the tallest in the solar system. Its orbit is tilted about 15 degrees from the plane of Saturn's equator. One idea is that the dark dust came from the Phoebe ring, far outside Saturn, and that ring was found by the Spitzer Space Telescope in 2009. On September 10, 2007, the Cassini spacecraft passed 1,600 km above and photographed the border between the dark and white land up close.
천왕성은 1781년 3월 13일 윌리엄 허셜이 처음에는 혜성으로 생각했습: When William Herschel first saw Uranus on March 13, 1781, he took it for a comet. Soon its orbit was found to be nearly circular, and it was accepted as a new planet. Herschel wanted to name it after King George III of Britain, but the name Uranus, proposed by the German Johann Bode, took hold. The lowest temperature in Uranus's atmosphere is minus 224 degrees, the lowest value measured on any planet. This is because it gives off almost no heat from its inside. Its rings were first found in March 1977 while astronomers watched Uranus pass in front of a star. Voyager 2 came within about 81,500 km on January 24, 1986.
미란다는 이름이 셰익스피어의 희곡 템페스트에 나오는 프로스페로의 딸에게서: Miranda is named after Prospero's daughter in Shakespeare's play The Tempest. It has three regions with racetrack-like patterns, named Arden, Inverness and Elsinore, and they are called coronae. Once there was even an idea that Miranda was shattered and then pulled back together, but today the patterns are thought to come from heat inside pushing the ice up. On January 24, 1986, Voyager 2 came as close as about 30,000 km to Miranda, and it did not get so near to any other large moon of Uranus. That is why the pictures of Miranda are the most detailed.
래셀은 영국 리버풀의 양조업자로, 직접 망원경을 만들어 별을 보던 아마추: Lassell was a brewer in Liverpool, England, and an amateur who built his own telescopes to watch the stars. On October 24, 1851, he found Ariel and Umbriel, and in 1846 he had also found Neptune's moon Triton. Ariel is named after an air spirit in a poem by Alexander Pope, and John Herschel chose the name in 1852. Among the moons of Uranus, carbon dioxide ice is most clearly seen on Ariel. The valleys tangled across its surface are thought to have formed as the crust cracked, and the largest are tens of kilometers wide.
움브리엘의 이름은 알렉산더 포프의 시 머리타래의 강탈에 나오는 우울한 정: Umbriel is named after a gloomy spirit in Alexander Pope's poem The Rape of the Lock, and the name also connects to umbra, the Latin word for shadow. John Herschel chose the name in 1852 at Lassell's request. The share of sunlight it reflects is about half that of Ariel. Why two moons so alike in size and distance are so different is still not known. The crater Wunda is about 131 km across. Umbriel orbits about 266,000 km from Uranus, and Voyager 2 passed about 325,000 km away in 1986, so the smallest features in its pictures are about 5 km across.
티타니아의 이름은 존 허셜이 1852년에 지었습니다. 밀도는 1cm³에: The name Titania was chosen by John Herschel in 1852. Its density is 1.71 g per cm³, and its largest crater, Gertrude, is about 326 km across and named after Hamlet's mother. Messina Chasmata is named after Messina, the city where Shakespeare's play Much Ado About Nothing is set. Voyager 2 came within about 365,000 km in 1986 and photographed about 40% of the surface. In September 2001 astronomers watched Titania pass in front of a star and confirmed that it has no thick atmosphere. Some craters have dark material spread on their floors.
Herschel found Titania and Oberon on the same day, January 11, 1787. He also believed he had seen four more moons, but they were all later shown to be mistakes. The names were chosen by John Herschel in 1852. The largest crater, Hamlet, is about 206 km across, followed by Othello at 114 km. Oberon orbits about 584,000 km from Uranus. Voyager 2 came only within about 470,000 km of Oberon in 1986 and photographed about 40% of the surface, so the other side of Oberon is still unknown.
해왕성은 프랑스의 위르뱅 르베리에와 영국의 존 쿠치 애덤스가 따로따로 자: Neptune's position was calculated separately by Urbain Le Verrier of France and John Couch Adams of Britain. Johann Galle of Germany received Le Verrier's calculation and found the planet right away on the night of September 23, 1846, at the Berlin Observatory, less than one degree from the predicted spot. The name comes from the Roman god of the sea. Voyager 2 came within about 4,950 km of the cloud tops on August 25, 1989. Neptune gives off 2.6 times more heat from the inside than it gets from the Sun. It has five rings, and the outermost one contains a few bright clumps.
트리톤은 해왕성이 발견된 지 17일 뒤인 1846년 10월 10일 영국의: Triton was found by William Lassell of Britain on October 10, 1846, 17 days after Neptune was discovered. The name comes from the son of Poseidon, the Greek god of the sea. Its orbit around Neptune is tilted 157 degrees to Neptune's equator, so it goes backward. Nitrogen ice reflects sunlight well, which makes the surface bright, and the nitrogen atmosphere is about one seventy-thousandth as thick as Earth's. In 1989, when Voyager 2 passed, it was summer in the southern hemisphere, and the geyser streaks were gathered on the bright land toward the south pole. A possible ocean below the surface has also been discussed.
세레스라는 이름은 로마 신화의 곡식의 여신에서 왔고, 피아치가 일하던 시: The name Ceres comes from the Roman goddess of grain, who was also the patron goddess of Sicily, where Piazzi worked. Piazzi observed it for 41 days before illness stopped him, and when Ceres vanished into the glare of the Sun, Gauss calculated its orbit with a new method, which made it possible to find it again in December 1801. The Dawn spacecraft was launched in 2007, reached Ceres on March 6, 2015, and ended its mission when its fuel ran out on November 1, 2018. It is still circling Ceres. The salt in the Occator basin is rich in sodium carbonate, which means salt water rose up to the surface until fairly recently.
명왕성의 영어 이름 플루토는 영국 옥스퍼드의 11세 소녀 베니셔 버니가: Pluto's name was suggested by Venetia Burney, an 11-year-old girl in Oxford, England, and it is the name of the Roman god of the underworld. At the Lowell Observatory in the United States, Clyde Tombaugh compared two photographic plates taken in January 1930 on February 18 and found a point that had moved, and the announcement came on March 13 of that year. New Horizons was launched in January 2006 and came within about 12,500 km on July 14, 2015. Part of Tombaugh's remains is carried aboard the probe. Pluto has five moons: Charon, Nix, Hydra, Kerberos and Styx.
카론의 이름은 제임스 크리스티가 아내 샤를린의 애칭 샤르에 맞춰 골랐고,: James Christy chose the name Charon to echo Char, his wife Charlene's nickname, and it also links to Charon, the ferryman in Greek myth who carries the dead across the river to the underworld. In June 1978 at the U.S. Naval Observatory, Christy noticed that the round image of Pluto in photographs had a bulge on one side, and he realized there was a moon. At Charon's north pole is a red patch called Mordor Macula, about 475 km across. Around the equator runs a canyon system up to 7.5 km deep. Charon orbits about 19,600 km from Pluto, and only after Hubble found Pluto's small moons Nix and Hydra in 2005 did it begin to be clear that Pluto has five moons.
핼리 혜성은 1066년 노르만 정복 때에도 나타나 바이외 태피스트리에 그: Halley's Comet appeared at the time of the Norman conquest in 1066 and is shown in the Bayeux Tapestry. Halley calculated from the comet of 1682 that it would return in 1758, but he died in 1742, and on December 25, 1758, a German farmer, Johann Palitzsch, spotted it himself, proving the prediction right. In 1910 Earth passed through the tail of this comet, and a rumor spread that the tail held poison gas, but no harm came of it. In 1986 the Soviet Vega 1 and 2, Japan's Sakigake and Suisei, and Europe's Giotto all went to study the nucleus together.
앨런 헤일은 미국 뉴멕시코에서, 토머스 밥은 애리조나에서 같은 날 혜성을: Alan Hale in New Mexico and Thomas Bopp in Arizona both saw the comet on the same day. Hale was an astronomer who had long watched comets, and Bopp was an amateur who was out looking at stars through a telescope. At perihelion on April 1, 1997, it was about 137 million km from the Sun, and it came closest to Earth on March 22, at about 197 million km. A tail of sodium was confirmed for the first time in this comet. It was a third tail besides the dust tail and the ion tail, and few comets have shed dust so actively from so far away.
추류모프는 알마아타 천문대에서 게라시멘코가 다른 혜성을 찍은 사진 건판을: At the Alma-Ata observatory, Churyumov was examining a photographic plate that Gerasimenko had taken of another comet, and he saw a comet near its edge. It was only much later that it turned out not to be the comet she meant to photograph, but a new one. Rosetta was launched on March 2, 2004, and ended its mission on September 30, 2016, by settling onto the comet's surface. Philae worked for about 64 hours on its battery and searched for organic molecules, then woke briefly and sent signals in June 2015. In the gas around the comet, hydrogen sulfide and ammonia, which smell like rotten eggs and horse urine, were detected. The nucleus has about half the density of water, so it has many empty spaces inside.
돈 탐사선은 2007년 발사되어 2011년 7월 16일 베스타에 도착했고: The Dawn spacecraft was launched in 2007, reached Vesta on July 16, 2011, and left on September 5, 2012. It was the first probe to orbit two different bodies in turn, using its xenon ion engine to move from Vesta to Ceres. Vesta's iron core has a radius of about 110 km. The Vesta meteorites found on Earth fall into three groups, howardites, eucrites and diogenites, so they are called HED meteorites after their initials. Thanks to these meteorites, people knew that Vesta was a body with a separated interior even before anyone went there.
오시리스-렉스는 2016년 9월 8일 발사되었습니다. 샘플 용기의 뚜껑을: OSIRIS-REx was launched on September 8, 2016. Two fasteners holding the lid of the sample container would not come loose, so it was only opened in January 2024. In January 2025 the research team announced that Bennu's sample contained 14 of the 20 amino acids that make up proteins, and all 5 of the bases of DNA and RNA. This supports the idea that the ingredients of life may have come to Earth on asteroids. OSIRIS-REx is carrying on with its mission under the new name OSIRIS-APEX and is due to approach the asteroid Apophis in April 2029.
하야부사2는 2014년 12월 3일 발사되었고, 하야부사는 일본말로 송골: Hayabusa2 was launched on December 3, 2014, and hayabusa means peregrine falcon in Japanese. On October 3, 2018, the lander MASCOT, built by Germany and France, touched down on Ryugu and worked on battery power for 17 hours, studying the surface. The samples resemble the least altered CI meteorites found on Earth, but unlike those they never met Earth's air and water, so they are free of contamination. In 2023 it was reported that more than 20 kinds of amino acids had been confirmed in the samples. The largest boulder, Otohime, is about 160 m tall and is named after the princess of the Dragon Palace.
디디모스는 규소가 많은 돌로 이루어진 S형 소행성이고, 밀도는 물의 약: Didymos is an S-type asteroid made of silicate rock, with a density about 2.2 times that of water. It is shaped like a spinning top, bulging at the middle, with a ridge running along its equator. It is an Apollo-type asteroid whose path crosses Earth's orbit, but when DART hit in September 2022 it was about 11 million km from Earth, roughly 29 times the distance to the Moon. About 15% of the asteroids that come near Earth are thought to be double systems like this one.
다트가 성공했다고 보는 기준은 공전 주기를 73초 이상 줄이는 것이었는데: DART was counted as a success if it shortened the orbit by at least 73 seconds, but the orbit shrank by 32 minutes, more than 25 times that. Dimorphos looks like a loose pile of boulders rather than a single solid block, and the material thrown out by the impact formed a tail that lasted for months. DART's last image was taken 2 seconds before impact and shows a patch of ground about 31 m wide. For its last four hours, DART flew with navigation that found the target on its own.
아포피스는 태양을 0.9년에 한 바퀴 돌면서 지구 궤도 안쪽과 바깥쪽을: Apophis is an Aten-type asteroid that goes around the Sun in 0.9 years, passing back and forth between the inside and outside of Earth's orbit. Its day lasts about 30 hours. At its closest on April 13, 2029, it will shine at about magnitude 3, similar to the stars of the Big Dipper, and will move quickly across the night sky. In 2021 radio telescopes at Goldstone and Green Bank in the United States measured it with radar, and its precise position showed it is safe for more than 100 years.
오우무아무아는 9월 9일 태양에 가장 가까이 갔을 때 약 3,800만km: When ʻOumuamua came closest to the Sun on September 9, it was about 38 million km away, inside the orbit of Mercury. On October 14 it passed about 24 million km from Earth. It came from the direction of Vega in the constellation Lyra and is now heading toward Pegasus. Which star it came from is unknown. It was recognized as an interstellar object because the eccentricity of its orbit is 1.2, greater than 1. Observations continued for nearly three months after its discovery.
아틀라스는 소행성 지구 충돌 마지막 경보 체계라는 영어 이름의 머리글자를: ATLAS stands for Asteroid Terrestrial-impact Last Alert System, and its telescopes are in Hawaii, Chile, South Africa and elsewhere. The I in 3I stands for interstellar, and the 3 means it is the third such object. The eccentricity of this comet's orbit is about 6, far larger than that of Comet Borisov (3.4) or ʻOumuamua (1.2). The larger the eccentricity, the straighter the path, and the less the object is bound to the Sun. Its closest distance to the Sun was about 1.36 AU.
에리스는 2010년 11월 칠레에서 별을 가리는 순간을 지켜본 관측으로: In November 2010, observers in Chile watched Eris pass in front of a star, and this measured its diameter at 2,326 km. New Horizons measured Pluto at about 2,377 km in 2015, so Eris is slightly smaller. At first Eris looked larger than Pluto. Its moon Dysnomia was found in September 2005 with the Keck telescope in Hawaii and is thought to be around 700 km across. The mass of Eris was worked out from the orbit of this moon.
2017년 하우메아가 별을 가리는 순간을 관측해 몸의 크기가 세 방향으로: A stellar occultation in 2017 gave Haumea new dimensions in three directions of about 2,322, 1,704 and 1,138 km. Its mass is about one third of Pluto's. The moon Hiʻiaka is about 300 km across and Namaka about 170 km. Haumea's orbit is tilted by about 28 degrees from the plane in which the planets move. The family of icy fragments from the same collision was first announced in 2007. Its surface is nearly pure water ice, so it is as bright as snow.
마케마케는 태양에서 가장 가까울 때 약 38AU, 가장 멀 때 약 53A: Makemake ranges from about 38 AU from the Sun at its closest to about 53 AU at its farthest, and its orbit is tilted by about 29 degrees from the plane in which the planets move. Its surface reflects about 80% of the sunlight that reaches it. Its mass is about a quarter of Pluto's, worked out from the orbit of its moon MK2. MK2 was found in Hubble images from April 2015 and announced in 2016. Few objects beyond Neptune shine this brightly. When it was discovered, it was about 52 AU from the Sun.
세드나는 태양에서 가장 가까울 때도 50AU보다 멀리 떨어진 세드노이드라: Sedna is the best-known member of a group called sednoids, objects that stay farther than 50 AU from the Sun even at their closest. Others in the group include 2012 VP113 (announced in 2014) and 2015 TG387 (announced in 2018). All of them follow orbits that Neptune's gravity barely reaches. Searches for a moon with the Hubble Space Telescope found none, and the length of Sedna's day is still unclear. When it was found, Sedna was about 90 AU from the Sun and moved only a tiny amount from one picture to the next.
The larger lobe, Wenu, is about 22 km long and the smaller lobe, Weyo, about 15 km, and the whole body turns once every 15.9 hours. The two lobes seem to have met and stuck together at a very slow speed, which is why there are so few impact marks. Its first nickname, Ultima Thule, was dropped after criticism that the old phrase has ties to the Nazis, and the name Arrokoth was announced in November 2019. The sharpest picture shows 33 m per pixel. The neck where the two lobes meet appears as a band brighter than its surroundings.
히페리온은 1981년 보이저 2호의 사진으로 처음 자세히 보였고, 198: Hyperion was first seen in detail in Voyager 2 images in 1981, and in 1984 Jack Wisdom and others in the United States calculated that with this shape and orbit its rotation axis could not help but wobble unpredictably. It was the first natural body found to tumble so chaotically. Its density is about half that of water. Cassini found water ice, carbon dioxide and organic compounds in the dark material. It orbits about 1.48 million km from Saturn, and its surface reflects about 25% of sunlight.
포에베는 토성의 큰 위성들과 달리 거꾸로 도는 작은 위성입니다. 카시니는: Phoebe is a small body that, unlike Saturn's large moons, orbits backward. Cassini found water ice, carbon dioxide and organic compounds on its surface. Its density is about 1.6 times that of water, similar to Pluto and Triton, which supports the idea that it came from the Kuiper belt. Cassini's close encounter that day was the only one. The faint ring was found in Spitzer data by Anne Verbiscer and colleagues in 2009. The high density means rock is mixed in with the ice.
프로테우스는 NASA 제트추진연구소의 스티븐 시노트가 보이저 2호의 사진: Proteus was found by Stephen Synnott of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Voyager 2 images, and at first it was known by the temporary designation S/1989 N 1. Long grooves and scarps can be seen on its surface. Voyager 2 found six new moons of Neptune at that time, and Proteus is the largest of them. It is bigger than Nereid, but it is dark and sits close against Neptune, so telescopes on Earth could not see it for a long time.
루시는 2027년 8월 12일 에우리바테스와 퀘타를 지난 뒤 폴리멜레와: After Eurybates and Queta on August 12, 2027, Lucy will pass Polymele and its moon, then Leucus in April 2028 and Orus in November 2028. Eurybates is a carbon-rich C-type asteroid whose surface is as dark as charcoal. These asteroids go around the Sun in about 12 years, the same as Jupiter, so Lucy can meet several different asteroids in one long journey. The data Lucy sends back will give clues about where in the solar system these asteroids were born.
반대로 앞쪽 무리에 있는 헥토르는 신화에서 파트로클로스를 쓰러뜨린 트로이: On the other side, in the leading swarm, is Hektor, named after the Trojan prince who killed Patroclus in the myths. Found by Kopff in 1907, Hektor is the largest Trojan asteroid, a peanut-shaped body about 400 km long with one moon. So the two asteroids, unlike in the myth, sit in each other's camp. Patroclus turns once every 4.3 days, and Menoetius goes around in the same time. These two have never yet been photographed from close up.
파트로클로스와 메노이티오스를 합친 밀도는 물의 약 0.9배로, 돌로만 이: The combined density of Patroclus and Menoetius is about 0.9 times that of water, whereas rock alone would be about 3 times. This means the interior is full of ice and empty gaps. The two bodies are nearly round and similar in size, so it is hard to say which one is the moon. Lucy will visit this pair last, on March 2, 2033. All we know of their shapes now is the outline measured from the time they block a star. Seen from Earth, the gap between them is only a fraction of an arcsecond, so only a large telescope can tell them apart.
2023년 11월부터 5개월 동안 보이저 1호는 뜻을 알 수 없는 신호만: From November 2023, Voyager 1 sent only meaningless signals for five months. One computer memory chip had failed, and in April 2024 NASA fixed the problem by moving the program to another part of the memory. The probe's computers were built in the 1970s. A signal takes about 23 hours to reach Earth, and around November 2026 the probe will reach a distance that light takes a full day to cross, about 26 billion km. The golden record holds 115 pictures and sounds of Earth.
천왕성에서는 1986년 1월 24일 구름 위 약 8만 1,500km 거리: At Uranus it passed about 81,500 km above the clouds on January 24, 1986, and at Neptune on August 25, 1989 it came within about 4,950 km of the north pole, photographing the Great Dark Spot and the dark plumes rising from Triton. In July 2023 a wrong command turned its antenna away by 2 degrees and contact was lost, but in early August a strong signal sent from Earth brought it back. At Uranus it first saw the deep canyons of the moon Miranda, and at Neptune winds of more than 2,000 km per hour.
허블은 지상 약 540km 위를 95분에 한 바퀴 돕니다. 원래 1986: Hubble circles about 540 km above the ground once every 95 minutes. It was first planned for launch in 1986 but was delayed by four years because of the Challenger accident. It recorded Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 hitting Jupiter in 1994, and a new camera was installed during the last repair in 2009. The gyroscopes that point the telescope have failed one by one, and since June 2024 it has observed with just one. It is expected to remain usable into the mid-2030s.
웹 망원경의 거울은 베릴륨 위에 금을 약 100nm 두께로 입혔고, 쓰인: The mirrors of the Webb telescope are beryllium coated with a layer of gold about 100 nm thick, using only about 48 g of gold in all. Gold reflects infrared light well. The area that collects light is 25 square meters, about 6 times that of Hubble. Its first pictures were released on July 12, 2022. It took 25 years to build and cost about 10 billion dollars. It has fuel for more than 20 years, and it is named after James Webb, who led NASA during the Apollo program.
케플러의 카메라는 9,500만 화소로, 하늘 한 곳을 30분마다 찍었습니: Kepler's camera had 95 million pixels and photographed one patch of sky every 30 minutes. In 2011 it confirmed Kepler-22b, the first planet found orbiting a Sun-like star at a distance where water could be liquid, and in 2014 it found Kepler-186f, an Earth-sized planet at such a distance. After the wheel failure it worked as K2 from 2014 to 2018, looking in turn at about twenty fields of sky along the ecliptic. Kepler's observations showed that planets larger than Earth and smaller than Neptune are the most common kind. Our own solar system has no such planet.
찬드라의 첫 사진은 1999년 8월에 공개한 카시오페이아자리의 초신성 잔: Chandra's first picture, released in August 1999, was of a supernova remnant in the constellation Cassiopeia. In 2006 it imaged the Bullet Cluster, where two galaxy clusters collided, and the visible gas and the unseen matter had separated, giving strong evidence that dark matter exists. Its mirrors are coated with iridium. It was planned to last 5 years but has worked for more than 25. Chandra means moon in Sanskrit. Chandra also caught Sagittarius A*, the black hole at the center of our galaxy, giving off occasional flashes of X-rays.
유클리드는 2023년 11월 7일 첫 시험 사진을 공개했고, 2025년: Euclid released its first test pictures on November 7, 2023, and in March 2025 it published its first dataset, covering 63 square degrees of sky and 26 million galaxies. In February 2025 it announced an Einstein ring around the galaxy NGC 6505. It is named after the Greek mathematician Euclid, and its visible-light camera has 600 million pixels. That one camera captures an area of two full moons in a single shot. Euclid looks at galaxies as far back as about 10 billion years ago to measure how the expansion of the universe has sped up over time.
국제우주정거장은 맑은 밤이면 맨눈으로 보입니다. 가장 밝을 때는 금성보다: The International Space Station can be seen with the naked eye on a clear night. At its brightest it outshines Venus. Its solar panels cover about 2,500 square meters in all and produce 75 → 90 kilowatts of electricity. More than 260 people have visited, and usually six or seven live aboard together. The first part launched was the Russian Zarya module on November 20, 1998, and the American Unity module was attached two weeks later.
톈허를 올린 것은 2021년 4월 29일 창정 5호 B 로켓이었고, 그해: Tianhe was launched on a Long March 5B rocket on April 29, 2021, and on June 17 that year three astronauts of Shenzhou 12 moved in for the first time and stayed about 90 days. China had earlier launched two small test stations, Tiangong 1 in 2011 and Tiangong 2 in 2016, and Tiangong 1 lost contact and fell into the South Pacific on April 2, 2018. The Shenzhou 14 crew finished the assembly in November 2022. Tianzhou cargo ships carry food and fuel. The goal is to keep using the station for more than 10 years. Tiangong is designed so that more modules can be added, up to six. The Shenzhou 13 crew in 2021 were the first to stay for six months.
설계를 이끈 사람은 소련의 세르게이 코롤료프였고, 스푸트니크는 R-7 로: The design was led by the Soviet engineer Sergei Korolev, and Sputnik rode an R-7 rocket from Baikonur in Kazakhstan. A month later, on November 3, 1957, the Soviet Union launched Sputnik 2 with the dog Laika, while the first American satellite, Explorer 1, only went up on January 31, 1958. Its signals were sent at 20.005 and 40.002 megahertz, and the satellite followed an elliptical orbit between 215 km and 939 km above the Earth. It kept circling in orbit for about two and a half months after its last signal ended.
하이라이즈는 2008년 피닉스가 낙하산을 펴고 내려오는 모습을, 2012: HiRISE photographed Phoenix coming down on its parachute in 2008, Curiosity in 2012 and Perseverance in 2021, all from above. The spectrometer CRISM found minerals made by water, such as clays and carbonates, building evidence that ancient Mars was wet. The dark streaks that lengthen each spring were once thought to be flowing salty water, but opinion has since leaned toward flows of dry sand and dust. The data it has sent to Earth now amounts to hundreds of terabits. A single HiRISE image covers a strip of ground about 6 km wide.
주노에는 레고 인형 셋이 타고 있습니다. 로마 신 유피테르, 그의 아내: Juno carries three LEGO figures made of aluminum: the Roman god Jupiter, his wife Juno, and Galileo Galilei. In 2019 it showed that the roots of the Great Red Spot reach 300 → 500 km below the clouds, and in December 2023 and February 2024 it came within about 1,500 km of Io and photographed its volcanoes up close. After its mission was extended it also passed Ganymede and Europa. Juno continued its mission until September 2025, and with its microwave instrument it also worked out how ammonia is spread deep in the atmosphere.
카시니는 2000년 12월 목성을 스쳐 지나며 속도를 얻었고, 토성에는: Cassini passed Jupiter in December 2000 to gain speed and reached Saturn on July 1, 2004. Over 13 years it sent back more than 450,000 pictures and passed Titan 127 times. From April 2017, in its final year, it made 22 dives through the gap of about 2,400 km between the rings and Saturn, and in doing so measured the mass of the rings and Saturn's gravity field from close range for the first time. The United States, Europe and Italy worked on it together. The science data Cassini collected amount to about 635 gigabytes.
파커는 2021년 4월 태양 바깥 대기 코로나 안으로 들어간 첫 탐사선이: In April 2021 Parker became the first spacecraft to enter the Sun's outer atmosphere, the corona. At about 13 million km from the Sun it crossed the boundary beyond which the Sun's magnetic field can no longer hold back the solar wind. It also found switchbacks, places where the magnetic field folds in a zigzag, in many places. A Delta IV Heavy rocket launched it, and Eugene Parker, then 91, watched the launch in person. Parker's four instrument suites measure the particles of the solar wind, the electric and magnetic fields, and how sunlight is scattered.
로드스터는 팰컨 헤비의 첫 발사에 실려 케네디 우주센터에서 올라갔고, 차: The Roadster rode the first Falcon Heavy launch from the Kennedy Space Center, and Musk said the song Space Oddity by David Bowie was set to play on repeat inside the car. The phrase Don't Panic, from The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, is shown on the dashboard, and the words Made on Earth by humans are engraved on the circuit board. The car weighs about 1,250 kg. In October 2020 it crossed the orbit of Mars and passed about 7.4 million km from the planet. At the launch, the two side boosters were also shown landing at Cape Canaveral at the same time.
2007년 2월 28일 목성 곁을 지나며 중력으로 속도를 초속 4km 더: On February 28, 2007, it passed Jupiter and gained another 4 km per second from its gravity, cutting 3 years off the trip to Pluto. Pluto was measured at about 2,377 km across, and its sky was revealed to hold layers of blue haze, with plains where nitrogen ice flows. Pluto's small moons Nix and Hydra were found by Hubble the year before launch, and the probe is now flying more than 60 AU from the Sun. It weighs about 478 kg and gets its electricity from a plutonium battery.
금속판은 칼 세이건과 프랭크 드레이크가 설계하고 린다 세이건이 그림을 그: The plaque was designed by Carl Sagan and Frank Drake, and Linda Sagan drew the pictures. It carries an image of the hydrogen atom and the directions to 14 pulsars, so that a finder can tell where and when it was sent from. On June 13, 1983, it crossed the orbit of Neptune and became the first spacecraft to leave the region of the planets, and in February 1998 it handed the title of most distant spacecraft to Voyager 1. The probe weighed only 258 kg, and the electricity from its plutonium batteries started at about 155 watts and slowly dropped.
다누리는 한국항공우주연구원이 만들었고 무게는 약 678kg입니다. 여섯: Danuri was built by the Korea Aerospace Research Institute and weighs about 678 kg. Its sixth instrument is a test device that exchanges data in space like the internet, and in September 2022 it was used to send a BTS Dynamite video from lunar orbit to Earth. After Danuri, Korea plans to send a lunar lander in 2032. The pictures Danuri takes of the polar regions are also expected to help choose its landing site. It entered lunar orbit on December 17, 2022, and at a height of 100 km it went around once in about 2 hours.
LRO는 2009년 6월 18일 엘크로스 탐사선과 같은 로켓에 실려 올랐: LRO was launched on June 18, 2009, on the same rocket as the LCROSS probe. On October 9, LCROSS's spent upper stage struck the crater Cabeus near the south pole, and water was found in the plume of dust it threw up. In December 2019 an ordinary citizen spotted the place where India's Vikram lander had crashed in an LRO image, and NASA confirmed it. LRO's laser altimeter measured heights billions of times to make a map of the Moon's highs and lows. Its neutron detector and temperature instrument picked out shaded polar craters where water ice is likely to be.
유로파의 얼음 껍질 아래 바다는 물의 양이 지구의 모든 바다를 합친 것의: The ocean under Europa's ice shell is thought to hold more than twice as much water as all of Earth's oceans put together. Clipper passed Mars in March 2025 and will pass Earth again in December 2026. A metal plate beside its instruments is engraved with a poem by the American poet Ada Limon and the names of 2.6 million people. The European Space Agency's Juice probe will also arrive at Jupiter in 2031 to study Ganymede and other moons. It will also look for water plumes rising from cracks in the ice, and if there are any, it will collect and analyze the particles in them as it passes.
루시가 2023년 11월 1일 처음 지난 소행성 딩키네시에서 발견된 위성: Selam, the moon found at the asteroid Dinkinesh that Lucy first passed on November 1, 2023, turned out to be two small lobes stuck together. Dinkinesh means marvelous in the Ethiopian language Amharic and is also the Ethiopian name of the Lucy fossil. In April 2025 Lucy passed an asteroid named after Donald Johanson, who found the fossil. The fossil got its name because the team at the dig was listening to the Beatles song Lucy in the Sky with Diamonds. A plaque carried by Lucy is engraved with words from people such as Carl Sagan, the Beatles and Martin Luther King Jr.
1973년 4월 6일 떠났고 1974년 12월 목성에서 처음으로 극지방을: It was launched on April 6, 1973, and at Jupiter in December 1974 it took the first close pictures of the polar regions. On September 1, 1979 it came within about 21,000 km of Saturn's cloud tops, crossed the ring plane, measured Saturn's magnetic field, and reported that Titan's temperature is around minus 180 degrees, too cold for life. The last contact came in September 1995. The data from Saturn were used to choose the paths of the Voyagers that followed. There was concern that it might be hit by dust while crossing the ring plane, but the probe came through safely.
2021년 10월 첫 수성 스침에서는 표면 200km 높이까지 다가가 사: On its first Mercury flyby in October 2021 it came within 200 km of the surface and sent back pictures. It weighed about 4,100 kg at launch, and a propulsion module that carries the two orbiters to Mercury stays attached until shortly before arrival, then is dropped. In April 2024 a problem with the electric power for the ion engines reduced its thrust, and the arrival slipped by almost a year, from December 2025 to November 2026. It is Europe's first mission to Mercury. The first planned period of observation after entering orbit is one year, and it can be extended by another year.
같은 로켓에는 태양 빛을 돛처럼 받아 나아가는 실험기 이카로스도 실려 있: The same rocket also carried IKAROS, a test craft that was pushed along by sunlight on a sail. The engine failure in December 2010 was traced to a blocked valve in the line that carries helium gas. The original plan was an orbit of about 30 hours, but because of the engine's condition it was changed in April 2016 to a long orbit of a little over 10 days, and the work went on from there. Before launch its name was Planet-C, and it weighs about 500 kg. Venus has long been called the morning star, which is why it was named Dawn.
2012년 8월 계획이 승인된 뒤 15개월 만에 만들어 떠났습니다. 무게: It was built and launched only 15 months after the plan was approved in August 2012. It weighed 1,337 kg with its fuel and carried five science instruments, including a color camera and a sensor for finding methane. In 2022 a long eclipse kept sunlight from reaching it, and its battery ran down, which is known as the reason contact was lost. With this, India became the first Asian country to reach Mars orbit. In 2015 it also gathered its pictures into an atlas of Mars.
베스타에는 폭 500km쯤의 거대한 충돌 구덩이가 남극 쪽에 있고, 그: On Vesta there is a huge impact basin about 500 km wide near the south pole, and the peak in its middle rises about 22 km. Ceres, about 940 km across, is the largest body in the asteroid belt, and Dawn also found Ahuna Mons there, an ice volcano about 4 km high. Dawn also confirmed that some of the meteorites that fall to Earth came from Vesta. Dawn was launched on a Delta II rocket and weighs about 1,200 kg. Occator, the crater on Ceres that holds the bright spots, is about 92 km across.
2024년 8월 19일과 20일에는 달과 지구를 하루 사이에 잇달아 스쳤: On 19 and 20 August 2024 it passed the Moon and then the Earth within a single day, a double flyby that had never been done before. The antenna of its ice-penetrating radar is 16 m long, and the instrument that measures magnetic fields sits at the end of a 10.6 m boom. Its study of Jupiter's moons pairs with the American Europa Clipper, which launched in October 2024. It carries ten instruments in all. Its launch mass was about 6,100 kg, and while circling Ganymede it will measure the thickness of the ice and the depth of the ocean.
류구는 1999년 미국의 린컨 근지구 소행성 탐사 팀이 찾았고, 이름은: Ryugu was found in 1999 by the American LINEAR asteroid survey, and its name comes from the undersea Dragon Palace in the old tale of Urashima Taro. The craft dropped two small rovers and MASCOT, a lander built by Germany and France, which worked for about 17 hours. The earlier Hayabusa brought back soil from Itokawa in 2010, the first craft to return soil from an asteroid to Earth. Ryugu has a density of about 1.2 times that of water and is a heap of rubble with many gaps inside. The capsule landed in the Woomera desert in Australia.
소호는 지구에서 약 150만km 떨어진 곳에서 태양을 살핍니다. 태양 속: SOHO watches the Sun from about 1.5 million km from Earth. By measuring sound-like vibrations inside the Sun, it worked out the Sun's inner structure and even the activity on the side facing away from Earth. It also tracks huge clouds of gas thrown out of the corona to see whether they head toward Earth, which helps give space weather warnings one to three days ahead. It weighed about 1,850 kg at launch and carries twelve science instruments. Anyone can look at SOHO's pictures on the internet right away.
2020년 첫 사진에서 태양 표면 곳곳에 아주 작은 폭발이 반짝이는 것을: In its first pictures in 2020 it found tiny explosions flickering all over the Sun's surface and named them campfires. They measure about 400 to 4,000 km. The heat shield is a titanium plate coated with black calcium phosphate, made so that it does not flake or shed dust under the heat. The spacecraft carries ten instruments in all, cameras included. It was launched from Cape Canaveral on an Atlas V rocket and weighs about 1,800 kg. In March 2022 it came to about one third of the distance between the Sun and the Earth.
탐사차 이름 주룽은 중국 신화의 불의 신에서 왔습니다. 무게는 약 240: The rover's name, Zhurong, comes from the god of fire in Chinese myth. It weighs about 240 kg and runs on solar power. A day on Mars is called a sol, and the plan was for 90 sols, but it worked for 347. After this mission, China launched Tianwen-2 in May 2025, bound for the asteroid Kamo'oalewa. It was launched from Wenchang on Hainan Island on a Long March 5 rocket. A study of the sand dunes that Zhurong examined reported a hard crust that bears marks of having been touched by water.
탐사선 이름은 기원, 분광 해석, 자원 확인, 안전, 표면 탐사를 뜻하는: The craft's name is made from the English words for origins, spectral interpretation, resource identification, security and regolith explorer. The name Bennu was chosen in 2013 from a contest, proposed by a nine-year-old student. In January 2019 it saw pebbles being thrown up from Bennu's surface for the first time. The chance that Bennu hits Earth on 24 September 2182 is calculated at about 1 in 2,700. It was launched from Cape Canaveral on an Atlas V rocket. Bringing back soil from an asteroid was a first for the United States.
디디모스는 지름 약 780m, 디모르포스는 약 160m입니다. 헤라는 팰: Didymos is about 780 m across and Dimorphos about 160 m. Hera was launched on a Falcon 9 rocket and weighs about 1,100 kg. The two small satellites it carries are Milani, from Italy, and Juventas, from Luxembourg; one takes detailed pictures and the other probes underground with radar. Once Hera weighs Dimorphos, scientists can work out exactly how hard DART pushed it. The name is that of the goddess of marriage in Greek myth. After DART hit it, Dimorphos trailed a tail of dust for months, and the Hubble Space Telescope photographed it.
테스가 처음 찾은 행성은 2018년 9월 발표된 지구에서 약 60광년 떨: The first planet TESS found, announced in September 2018, was Pi Mensae c, around a star about 60 light-years from Earth. In 2020 it found TOI-700 d, a planet 1.2 times the size of Earth that orbits at a distance where water could be liquid. That star is a little over 100 light-years away. Besides planets, it also records the changing brightness of exploding stars and comets. The field of view of the four cameras joined together is a strip 24 degrees wide and 96 degrees long. It was launched on a Falcon 9 rocket, and the first mission period was set at two years.
가이아는 소유스 로켓에 실려 떠났고, 6시간에 한 바퀴씩 천천히 돌면서: Gaia was launched on a Soyuz rocket and swept the sky by turning slowly, one revolution every 6 hours. Its telescope mirrors are made of silicon carbide, a hard ceramic whose shape does not change when the temperature does. Earlier star catalogs came out in 2016, 2018 and 2022, and the next one is due as early as December 2026. The camera is not a single one but 106 sensors joined together. Science observations began in July 2014.
The lead scientist of Psyche is Lindy Elkins-Tanton of Arizona State University. Once at the asteroid, the craft will orbit at changing heights, starting at 700 km, then dropping to 290 km and 190 km, and finally down to about 75 km. Its instruments are cameras, a spectrometer that measures gamma rays and neutrons, and magnetometers. The asteroid 16 Psyche is thought to make up about 1% of the mass of the whole asteroid belt. Its launch mass was about 2,600 kg. It does not land on the asteroid but only orbits and studies it.
이름은 이집트 상형문자를 풀어낸 로제타석에서 땄습니다. 혜성이 태양계의: The name comes from the Rosetta Stone, which unlocked Egyptian hieroglyphs, meaning that comets are a key to the origin of the solar system. From June 2011 to January 2014, 957 days in all, Rosetta slept to save power. The lander Philae bounced three times and ended up tilted in the shade of a cliff with no sunlight, worked about 64 hours on its battery and stopped. Philae's resting place was only found in a photo on 2 September 2016. Churyumov-Gerasimenko is shaped like a rubber duck and is about 4 km long. The comet came closest to the Sun in August 2015.
목성의 고리는 작은 위성들에서 떨어져 나온 먼지로 이루어졌다는 것을 갈릴: Galileo showed that Jupiter's rings are made of dust knocked off its small moons. In November 2002 it passed within 160 km of the inner moon Amalthea, which is less dense than water and is closer to a heap of rubble. The probe that plunged into Jupiter's atmosphere reported less water than expected and strong winds of about 640 km/h that continue to great depth. Jupiter's intense radiation caused the instruments to misbehave many times, but Galileo kept working for more than eight years, longer than planned.
메신저는 12시간에 한 바퀴 도는 길쭉한 궤도로 수성의 가까운 곳은 20: MESSENGER traveled a long orbit that took 12 hours per revolution, passing as close as 200 km and as far as about 15,000 km from Mercury. It showed that the center of Mercury's magnetic field sits about 480 km north of the planet's center, and that the metal core inside is very large, about 85% of the planet's radius. It circled Mercury more than 4,000 times, and craters it found are named after artists. The first complete map of all of Mercury's surface was made in March 2013. The map was completed thanks to the mission having been extended twice.
사령관은 닐 암스트롱이고 사령선 조종사는 마이클 콜린스였습니다. 아폴로: The commander was Neil Armstrong and the command module pilot was Michael Collins. Apollo 11 left Kennedy Space Center on a Saturn V rocket on July 16 and splashed down in the Pacific on July 24. About 600 million people are said to have watched the scene on the Moon on television. Fearing lunar germs, the three men were kept in quarantine for 21 days after returning. A plaque on the Moon says the crew came in peace for all mankind. The whole trip took about 8 days and 3 hours. The name Eagle was taken from the bald eagle that symbolizes the United States.
착륙선은 1982년 토머스 머치 기념 기지라는 이름을 받았습니다. 영상팀: In 1982 the lander was named the Thomas Mutch Memorial Station, after the head of the imaging team, who had died in a mountain accident in 1980. Five days after the landing, on July 25, the orbiter photographed a hill in the Cydonia region that looked like a human face; sharper pictures later showed it to be an ordinary hill. In the first color pictures the Martian sky was pink because of dust. The lander weighed about 576 kg. Its weather instruments measured Mars's temperature and winds for six years.
하위헌스는 무게 318kg, 너비 2.7m의 둥근 탐사체입니다. 2004: Huygens is a round probe weighing 318 kg and 2.7 m across. It separated from Cassini on 25 December 2004 and flew alone for about 20 days. It entered Titan's atmosphere at about 6 km/s, slowed down behind a heat shield that withstood the burning heat, and then opened its parachute. On landing its sensors showed a thin crust over soft ground, and it also detected methane seeping out of the surface. On Earth, radio telescopes picked up Huygens's signal separately and confirmed where it had come down. It landed near the bright region called Adiri.
카시니는 1997년 10월 15일 타이탄 4B 로켓으로 떠났고, 7년을: Cassini was launched on a Titan IVB rocket on 15 October 1997, flew for seven years and entered orbit around Saturn in July 2004. Its name comes from Giovanni Cassini, an Italian-born astronomer who found the gap in Saturn's rings in 1675. In July 2013 it photographed the distant Earth beyond the rings from within Saturn's shadow. It also found several new moons. That gap is called the Cassini Division and is about 4,800 km wide. While it was there, Cassini also watched the seasons change once on Saturn.
뉴허라이즌스는 초속 약 16km로 지구를 떠나, 인류가 쏘아 올린 물체: New Horizons left Earth at about 16 km/s, the fastest departure speed of any object humanity has launched. In February 2007 it passed Jupiter and used its gravity to gain speed, which brought the arrival at Pluto forward by three years. Some of the ashes of Clyde Tombaugh, who discovered Pluto, ride aboard, and Pluto's heart-shaped land is named Tombaugh Regio after him. The craft is about the size of a piano and weighs about 478 kg. Far from the Sun, it makes its electricity from the heat of plutonium.
지오토는 1985년 7월 2일 아리안 1 로켓으로 떠났고, 유럽우주국이: Giotto was launched on an Ariane 1 rocket on 2 July 1985, and it was the first deep-space probe that the European Space Agency launched. It met Halley's Comet at a relative speed of about 68 km/s. Because dust grains fly faster than bullets, thin layered shields were fitted at the front. The comet's dust was full of carbon-rich grains, containing light elements that are building blocks of life. The dust it hit at closest approach made the craft wobble, and contact was lost for about 32 minutes before it came back.
1979년 3월 보이저 1호가 찍은 사진에서 린다 모라비토가 이오 가장자: In March 1979 Linda Morabito spotted a volcanic plume rising from the edge of Io in a picture taken by Voyager 1. It was the first time an eruption had been seen on a world other than Earth. Passing Titan in 1980 bent Voyager 1's path out of the plane where the planets lie. In November 2023 a fault in its computer memory made it send meaningless signals, but engineers on Earth repaired it in April 2024. It weighs about 825 kg. Its computer memory is about 69 KB, far smaller than a single photo today.
세이건이 카메라를 돌려 달라고 졸랐을 때 이를 받아들인 사람은 당시 나사: When Sagan pleaded for the camera to be turned around, the person who agreed was Richard Truly, then head of NASA. In 1994 Sagan published a book named after the picture, Pale Blue Dot. After the picture was taken, the programs for Voyager 1's cameras were also erased, so the cameras could never be turned on again. The dot in this picture is our home as seen from the edge of the solar system. The picture was taken from a spot about 32 degrees above the plane in which the Earth lies. It was a distance that light takes about five and a half hours to cross.
독도의 면적은 187,554제곱미터로, 축구장 26개쯤의 넓이입니다. 1: Dokdo covers 187,554 square meters, about the size of 26 soccer pitches. It was designated Natural Monument No. 336 in 1982. Seaside plants such as Sedum takesimense and sea chrysanthemum grow in the cracks of the rock, and there are almost no trees. The two main islands lie about 150 m apart. Rock formations such as Independence Gate Rock and the ceiling cave were carved over a long time by waves and wind. Measured from the sea floor, the island stands more than 2,000 m high. On Seodo there is a spring called Mulgol where water wells up and people can drink it.
루나 2호는 1959년 9월 12일 떠나 약 34시간을 날았고 무게는 약: Luna 2 left on 12 September 1959, flew for about 34 hours and weighs about 390 kg. It hit near the group of craters Aristillus, Archimedes and Autolycus. On the way it also confirmed that the Moon has no radiation belt like Earth's, and it was one of the first craft to measure the solar wind, the stream of particles from the Sun. Khrushchev, on a visit to the United States, gave Eisenhower a replica of the emblem. The Jodrell Bank observatory in Britain followed Luna 2's radio signal and confirmed the time of impact.
루나 9호는 1966년 1월 31일 떠나 나흘 뒤 내렸고, 달에 닿은 시: Luna 9 left on 31 January 1966 and landed four days later, reaching the Moon at 18:45 UT on 3 February. It came down near the craters Reiner and Marius. It sent pictures in seven sessions totaling a little over 8 hours. The Soviet Union had failed eleven times before to land on the Moon, so Luna 9 was a success on the twelfth try. The pictures showed ground strewn with small stones and fine grains. Four months later, in June, the American Surveyor 1 landed on the Moon. Luna 9 weighed 1,538 kg, of which the capsule placed on the Moon was about 100 kg.
서베이어 1호는 1966년 5월 30일 아틀라스-센타우르 로켓으로 떠나: Surveyor 1 was launched on an Atlas-Centaur rocket on 30 May 1966 and reached the Moon a little over 63 hours later. Its mass on the Moon was about 294 kg. The first pictures arrived minutes after landing. It woke up and worked again after the two-week lunar night, and its last contact was in January 1967. In 2009 the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter photographed the lander's site from above. It landed inside an old crater called Flamsteed P. It turned its camera to take a 360-degree panorama and sent a little over 10,000 pictures during the first lunar day alone, and a little over 800 more after getting through the night. Surveyor 1 was built by Hughes Aircraft and run by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
알파 입자를 쏘아 흙의 성분을 재는 장치가 처음에는 땅에 내려오지 않았는: The device that fires alpha particles to measure the soil's makeup at first failed to lower itself to the ground, but controllers on Earth pressed it down with the robot arm and it worked. The results showed that the highland soil has less iron and more aluminum than the soil of the seas. This led scientists to conclude that the highlands are made of lighter rock. Surveyor 7 got through a second lunar night and lost contact in February 1968. It left on an Atlas-Centaur rocket on January 7 and arrived three days later. The landing site is about 29 km north of Tycho's rim, and the bright rays spreading from Tycho are counted among the most prominent on the Moon as seen from Earth.
사령관 피트 콘래드, 달 착륙선 조종사 앨런 빈, 사령선 조종사 리처드: The crew was commander Pete Conrad, lunar module pilot Alan Bean and command module pilot Richard Gordon. The lander was named Intrepid and the command ship Yankee Clipper. The two men brought back about 34 kg of rock and soil, and left a set of instruments powered by a nuclear battery, which kept working until 1977. When the upper part of the departed lander was crashed into the Moon, the Moon rang like a bell for nearly an hour. It launched from Kennedy Space Center on November 14.
루나 16호는 1970년 9월 12일 떠났습니다. 달에 머문 시간은 26: Luna 16 left on 12 September 1970. It stayed on the Moon for about 26 hours, and the upper stage that rose from the ground brought back a small return capsule. It landed in the Sea of Fertility near the crater Webb. The soil it brought back was dark gray, fine-grained and basaltic. Luna 15, which was meant to compete with Apollo 11 in July 1969, crashed into the Moon and failed. It was also the first time a robot lifted off by itself from another world. The capsule landed about 80 km southeast of Dzhezkazgan in Kazakhstan on September 24, and the lower part of the lander is still on the Sea of Fertility today.
루노호트 1호는 달의 낮 사흘, 곧 석 달쯤만 일하도록 설계되었는데 열한: Lunokhod 1 was designed to work for only three lunar days, about three months, but it survived eleven lunar days. Four television cameras lit up the road and the ground for its drivers, and it measured the soil's composition and hardness at 25 places. The laser reflector on its back was built by France. Its last contact was in September 1971, and it is thought that it ran short of heat and could not get through the night. Luna 17 left on a Proton rocket on November 10, 1970. The rover looked like a tub-shaped body with a round lid, and each of its eight wheels had its own motor, so it could keep rolling even if one failed.
승무원은 앨런 셰퍼드, 에드거 미첼, 스튜어트 루사입니다. 달로 가는 길: The crew was Alan Shepard, Edgar Mitchell and Stuart Roosa. On the way to the Moon the command ship and the lander succeeded in docking only on the sixth try. Just before landing, an abort switch kept signaling falsely, but the team on the ground wrote a fix to the program and sent it up, so the landing could go ahead. The largest rock the two men brought back weighs about 9 kg and was nicknamed Big Bertha. It left Kennedy Space Center on January 31, 1971. The time spent on the Moon's surface was about 33 and a half hours.
승무원은 데이비드 스콧, 제임스 어윈, 앨프리드 워든입니다. 두 사람은: The crew was David Scott, James Irwin and Alfred Worden. The two men stayed on the Moon for 66 hours 55 minutes, went outside three times and worked about 18 and a half hours in all, and brought back 77 kg of rock and soil. The Genesis Rock turned out to be more than 4 billion years old. On the way home one of the three parachutes failed to open, but the capsule still landed safely in the sea on the other two. It left on July 26, 1971. Scott left a small satellite in lunar orbit before heading home.
승무원은 존 영, 찰스 듀크, 켄 매팅리입니다. 두 사람은 달에 71시간: The crew was John Young, Charles Duke and Ken Mattingly. The two men stayed on the Moon for about 71 hours and drove the rover at up to about 17 km/h, setting a speed record on the Moon. The largest rock they brought back weighs 11.7 kg, the biggest returned by Apollo, and was named Big Muley. Young later flew the first Space Shuttle, Columbia, in 1981. John Young flew into space six times, including on Gemini 3. Apollo 16 left on April 16, 1972, and its command module pilot Ken Mattingly, who had been taken off Apollo 13 over fear of rubella, flew this time. The command ship was named Casper and the lander Orion.
아폴로 17호는 1972년 12월 7일 한밤중에 떠났고, 새턴 5호가 밤: Apollo 17 lifted off at night on 7 December 1972, the first Saturn V launched after dark. It was the last Saturn V to fly to the Moon. The two men stayed on the Moon for about 75 hours while the command module pilot, Ronald Evans, circled the Moon alone. Schmitt later became a United States senator, representing New Mexico. In all, twelve people have walked on the Moon. The rock and soil they brought back came to 110.5 kg, the most of any Apollo mission. The lander was named Challenger and the command ship America.
루나 21호는 1973년 1월 8일 프로톤 로켓으로 떠나 15일에 내렸습: Luna 21 left on a Proton rocket on 8 January 1973 and landed on the 15th. Lunokhod 2 sent back 86 panoramic pictures and more than 80,000 television pictures. It carried instruments to measure the soil, a magnetometer and a device to measure the brightness of the sky. It even drove across a cleft valley on the Moon. Its last contact was in May 1973. Lemonnier crater lies between the Sea of Serenity and the Taurus Mountains, and it was chosen for studying the border between the sea and the highlands. This rover also carried a laser reflector built by France.
루나 24호는 1976년 8월 9일 발사되어 8월 18일 달에 내렸습니다: Luna 24 was launched on August 9, 1976, and reached the Moon on August 18. A drill on an arm pushed a long, flexible tube into the ground, and the tube full of soil was coiled up and placed in the return capsule. The capsule came down in Siberia, southeast of Surgut, on August 22. The soil kept its layers inside the tube, so scientists could see how the ground was built below the surface. The Soviet Union and the United States also exchanged parts of their lunar samples for study. The Soviet Union brought back lunar soil three times, with Luna 16 in 1970, Luna 20 in 1972 and Luna 24, and the total comes to about 330 g. That is very little next to the 382 kg that Apollo brought back in six missions.
창어 3호는 2013년 12월 2일 쓰촨성 시창에서 발사되어 열이틀 뒤: Chang'e 3 was launched from Xichang in Sichuan on December 2, 2013, and landed twelve days later. During the descent it paused about 100 m above the Moon, scanned the ground with a camera and a laser, and picked a spot free of rocks. The name of the rover, Yutu, was chosen by an online vote. It weighed 140 kg, and in January 2014, before its second lunar night, a mechanical fault left it unable to drive properly. Yutu officially ended its mission in August 2016. China's lunar exploration is planned in three steps: orbiting, landing and returning. Chang'e 1 (2007) and Chang'e 2 (2010) handled orbiting, and Chang'e 3 handled landing.
창어 4호보다 앞선 2018년 5월, 중계 위성 췌차오가 달 뒤쪽 약 6: Before Chang'e 4, in May 2018, the relay satellite Queqiao was placed in an orbit around a Lagrange point about 65,000 km beyond the Moon. The lander was launched on December 8, 2018, and took nearly a month to come down. A study published in Nature in 2019 reported that Yutu-2 found minerals that seem to come from the lunar mantle. The rover also passed the record of about 11 months set by Lunokhod 1 and became the longest-working rover on the Moon. A German radiation detector was on board as well. Besides cotton seeds, the canister held potato, rapeseed and thale cress seeds, as well as yeast and fruit fly eggs. A lunar day lasts about two weeks on Earth, so Yutu-2 has worked by day and gone to sleep each night, again and again.
창어 5호는 2020년 11월 23일 하이난섬의 원창에서 창정 5호 로켓: Chang'e 5 was launched on November 23, 2020, from Wenchang on Hainan Island aboard a Long March 5 rocket. The lander gathered samples with a drill that reached 2 m deep and a scoop, and it worked on the Moon for about two days. The ascent vehicle carrying the soil lifted off on December 3, the first time China had launched anything from the Moon. A national flag made of fabric was also unfurled on the surface. In 2022 a new mineral, named changesite, was identified in the samples. The spacecraft was made of four parts: an orbiter, a returner, a lander and an ascender. The return capsule came down on the grasslands of Inner Mongolia, and the whole trip from launch to return took 24 days.
찬드라얀 3호는 2023년 7월 14일 인도 남동쪽 스리하리코타에서 발사: Chandrayaan-3 was launched on July 14, 2023, from Sriharikota on India's southeastern coast and landed 40 days later. After its main work was done, the lander Vikram fired its engines again, hopped about 40 cm and set down, as a test for future missions. The instrument that measured ground temperature reported about 70 degrees at the surface but about minus 10 degrees only 8 cm below. India has made August 23, the day of the landing, its National Space Day. Chandrayaan means moon vehicle in Sanskrit. Vikram is named after Vikram Sarabhai, the father of India's space program, Pragyan comes from a word meaning wisdom, and the rover weighs 26 kg.
슬림은 2023년 9월 7일 다네가시마 우주센터에서 엑스리즘 위성과 함께: SLIM was launched on September 7, 2023, from the Tanegashima Space Center together with the XRISM satellite. On the way down it recognized the shapes of craters with a camera and matched them with a map stored beforehand to find its position. After landing, it was switched off when the battery had 12 percent left, and eight days later it woke up and photographed nearby rocks. The rocks were given names of dog breeds, such as Toy Poodle, and a multi-band camera measured their olivine content. SLIM is short for Smart Lander for Investigating Moon. It is a small lander of about 200 kg without fuel, and it took more than four months from launch to touchdown.
오디세우스는 2024년 2월 15일 팰컨 9 로켓으로 발사됐습니다. 키: Odysseus was launched on February 15, 2024, on a Falcon 9 rocket. It is a six-sided column 4.3 m tall, and it was the first lander to come down on engines burning liquid methane and liquid oxygen. It landed at 80 degrees south, about 300 km from the pole, which was the closest to the pole of any landing at the time. It carried six NASA instruments and commercial experiments, and contact ended in late February when the Sun set on the site. Intuitive Machines is a company based in Houston, Texas. Odysseus also carried an artwork by the artist Jeff Koons made up of 125 tiny moon sculptures.
창어 6호는 2024년 5월 3일 원창에서 발사됐고, 앞서 3월에 올린: Chang'e 6 was launched from Wenchang on May 3, 2024, and the relay satellite Queqiao-2, sent up in March, kept it in contact with the far side. The lander gathered soil with a drill and a scoop, worked for about two days, and on June 4 made the first liftoff ever from the far side of the Moon. The ascent vehicle met the orbiter in lunar orbit and passed the samples over. The lander also unfurled a fabric Chinese flag on the far side. Later analysis suggested that the mantle under the far side holds less water than the near side. The return capsule came down at Siziwang Banner in Inner Mongolia, the same place where the capsule of Chang'e 5 landed. The Apollo basin where it landed is about 500 km across, a smaller impact basin inside the South Pole-Aitken basin.
The name Blue Ghost comes from a species of firefly that lives in the southeastern United States. It was launched on January 15, 2025, on a Falcon 9 rocket together with the lander of Japan's ispace. Its X-ray camera, LEXI, imaged the magnetic field around Earth, and it also tested a device that shakes dust off with electricity and one that measures how strongly lunar soil sticks to surfaces. It kept sending data for about four hours after the Sun had set. Firefly is a company based in Texas. Blue Ghost is a small lander 2 m tall and 3.5 m wide, and it was the third lander sent to the Moon under NASA's commercial lunar delivery program. Of the first two, one never reached the Moon and the other fell over.
마스 3호는 1971년 5월 28일 발사되어 12월 2일 화성에 닿았습니: Mars 3 was launched on May 28, 1971, and reached Mars on December 2. Its lander weighed 358 kg, and after separating from the orbiter it slowed down using air friction, a parachute and retro-rockets. The small rover Prop-M was meant to stay connected to the lander by a 15 m cable. In November of the same year the American Mariner 9 had already entered Mars orbit and was waiting for the dust storm to settle. The Mars 3 orbiter measured surface temperatures from minus 110 to plus 13 degrees Celsius. The lander's signal was received by the orbiter and relayed to Earth.
바이킹 2호는 1975년 9월 9일 발사되어 1976년 8월 7일 화성: Viking 2 was launched on September 9, 1975, entered orbit around Mars on August 7, 1976, and came down after almost a month of studying landing sites. The lander made electricity from two nuclear power units, which let it last a long time, and sent its final signal on April 11, 1980. In October 1977 the orbiter came within about 30 km of Mars's small moon Deimos to photograph it, and in July 1978 a leak of gas used for attitude control ended its mission. The two Vikings together sent back more than 50,000 pictures. The lander carried three life-detection experiments and a gas analyzer to look for organic matter in the soil. The analyzer found no organic matter, and this result is one of the reasons why the life experiments are still read in different ways.
패스파인더의 설계 수명은 착륙선 30일, 소저너 7일이었는데 모두 몇 배: Pathfinder was designed to last 30 days for the lander and 7 days for Sojourner, and both lasted several times longer. The lander sent back more than 16,000 pictures, and Sojourner took about 550 of its own. Nearby rocks were given the names of cartoon characters such as Barnacle Bill and Yogi, and Sojourner measured what they were made of. Along the way the computer kept stopping on its own, and engineers on Earth fixed it by sending up a software patch. Landing with airbags to cushion the impact was used for the first time on Mars by this mission, and Spirit and Opportunity later used it too.
Beagle 2 was a 33 kg lander built under the leadership of Colin Pillinger of Britain. It was launched with Mars Express on June 2, 2003, separated from the orbiter on December 19, and came down six days later. The tune meant to announce a successful landing was composed by the British band Blur, and the artist Damien Hirst painted colored spots on a calibration chart for its cameras. In January 2015 the UK Space Agency announced that Beagle 2 had landed but that its solar panels had not fully opened. Beagle 2 also came down with a parachute and airbags.
스피릿과 오퍼튜니티라는 이름은 미국 애리조나에 사는 러시아 출신 아홉 살: The names Spirit and Opportunity were picked from an essay by Sofi Collis, a nine-year-old girl of Russian birth living in Arizona. Seventeen days after landing in January 2004, a memory problem briefly broke contact, but it was fixed. In August 2005 Spirit climbed to the top of Husband Hill, about 100 m high, and later found signs of volcanic activity meeting water on a round feature called Home Plate. Its last contact came on March 22, 2010, and the mission was officially ended on May 25, 2011.
오퍼튜니티는 2015년 3월 마라톤 거리 42.195km를 달렸고, 11: In March 2015 Opportunity completed the distance of a marathon, 42.195 km, which took it 11 years and 2 months. In 2005 its wheels sank into the Purgatory Dune and it was stuck for more than five weeks before it worked free. In 2011 it reached the rim of Endeavour Crater and found a striped rock containing gypsum, a mineral that forms in water. Its last contact came on June 10, 2018, and by then it had worked for more than 5,100 sols, which are Martian days.
피닉스는 2007년 8월 4일 발사되어 10개월 가까이 날아 내렸고, 에: Phoenix was launched on August 4, 2007, flew for almost ten months, and slowed down for landing with retro-rockets instead of airbags. It was led by Peter Smith of the University of Arizona, making it the first NASA Mars mission led by a university. Its robotic arm was 2.35 m long, and the trenches it dug were given names such as Snow White. When soil was mixed with water and tested, it turned out to be mildly alkaline rather than acidic, and it contained calcium carbonate. It was the first spacecraft to land on ground near the north pole of Mars, and it sent its last signal on November 2, when winter sunlight ran short.
착륙한 자리는 SF 작가 레이 브래드버리를 기려 브래드버리 착륙지라 부릅: The landing spot is called Bradbury Landing in honor of the science fiction writer Ray Bradbury. In February 2013, in Yellowknife Bay, Curiosity drilled into a Martian rock for the first time and collected a sample, and the clay minerals in it showed that the old water was neither acidic nor very salty. In 2018 scientists announced that they had found organic molecules in mudstone about 3.5 billion years old. The rover keeps climbing Mount Sharp, which is more than 5 km high, reading the layers of rock as it goes. The name Curiosity was chosen from an essay by Clara Ma, a twelve-year-old girl in Kansas.
인사이트는 2018년 5월 5일 미국 캘리포니아에서 발사되어, 그곳에서: InSight was launched on May 5, 2018, from California, making it the first interplanetary spacecraft sent up from there. On April 6, 2019, it heard its first marsquake. The biggest quake it recorded was a magnitude 5 event in May 2022. To shield the seismometer from wind and changes in temperature, it was covered with a round dome. It was also the first time on another planet that a robotic arm set instruments directly down on the ground. The name InSight is short for an English phrase meaning to explore the inside of Mars with quakes and heat.
퍼서비어런스라는 이름은 버지니아의 중학생 알렉스 매더가 쓴 글로 정했습니: The name Perseverance came from an essay by Alex Mather, a middle school student in Virginia. It was launched on July 30, 2020, and jezero means lake in the Slavic languages. MOXIE ran 16 times in all and made 122 g of oxygen. From December 2022 to January 2023 the rover set ten sample tubes down in one place, leaving behind Three Forks, the first sample depot on another planet. In July 2024 it found a rock called Cheyava Falls, marked with leopard-like spots.
